actual: A monthly --candidate-only request produced by DatasetReleaseControlService includes supplied_preview_token, but MonthlyResolutionProcessor requires the exact _MONTHLY_FIELDS set without that field. The healthy qe_hmm_full_v2 Worker therefore moves every valid operator submission to BLOCKED_CONTRACT with BLOCKED_RESOLUTION_REQUEST_INVALID before run creation. Preserve strict unknown-field rejection while accepting and validating the optional signed preview-token field; keep reconciler/legacy requests without the field compatible.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
